name: feature.agent-author.nodes
description: Agent Author node pack (ADR 0514) — describe-to-create for the digital workforce over the ctx.features['agent-author'] surface. get (closed-world catalog: visible agents, tenant workflows, roster, autonomy levels), draft (LLM authors a roster-entry draft with bounded error-fed repair), validate (closed-world re-check), persist (create through the SHARED wizard path; the agent lands DISABLED for human review — or mode:'draft' stashes the validated draft for the manual wizard's prefill, ADR 0514 OQ1).
author: OpenWOP App

nodes.label: Agent Author: Catalog
nodes.description: Reads the closed world for agent authoring: visible agents, the tenant's workflow ids, the current roster (read-before-write), and the legal autonomy levels. Requires ctx.features['agent-author'].

nodes.label: Agent Author: Draft
nodes.description: Reads the closed world and calls the LLM to author a candidate roster-agent draft for a natural-language intent, repairing on validation errors up to maxAttempts. Requires ctx.callAI + ctx.features['agent-author'].

nodes.label: Agent Author: Validate
nodes.description: Closed-world re-check of a candidate draft (agentId in catalog, workflows resolve, persona distinct, autonomy legal). Fails the run when invalid so the errors feed a repair.

nodes.label: Agent Author: Persist
nodes.description: Validates and creates the agent through the SAME createRosterEntry path the manual wizard uses (deterministic id, duplicate-409). The created agent lands DISABLED for human review-and-enable. mode:'draft' stashes the VALIDATED draft for the wizard prefill instead of creating (OQ1).
